'''Vee Naaq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] who went against his [[Species/Legends|species']] social structure to become a [[Poet/Legends|poet]] instead of a fluidics [[Technician/Legends|technician]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

Vee Naaq fell in love with [[Cera Vixe]], but her [[Rae Vixe|father]] had banned her from seeing her love. In response, Naaq hired a group of individuals to "rescue" Vixe from her father. After learning of the rescue, Cera's brother [[Boe Vixe]] offered them more to walk away from the deal.<ref name="FP">{{WEGCite|book=Instant Adventures|story=Family Problems}}</ref>
